label: simulation
definition: System or algorithm evaluated in simulator/synthetic environment
minimum_evidence: named simulator/model or reproducible synthetic setup

label: testbed
definition: Integrated system evaluated on a controlled hardware/network testbed

label: pilot
definition: System evaluated with target-domain users/processes in a limited real setting
minimum_evidence: real setting, bounded scale, observed outcomes

label: operational_deployment
definition: System used in ongoing real operations
minimum_evidence: operational context, duration/scale, observed service evidence

label: multi_site_replication
definition: Comparable operational evidence across independent sites/settings
